title: The uniquely normalized scalar tensor isomorphism on good representatives
statement: Select the uniquely determined good-representative natural isomorphism proved by integralScalarTensorGoodComparison. Its hom component at every good pair is exactly Q.map scalarTensorChain, so it is fully determined up to equality and is not an arbitrary existence witness.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0941; categories.tex, Tag 04VK (fully faithful localization descent).

proof.text: The completely proved integralScalarTensorGoodComparison theorem is ExistsUnique with every hom component prescribed to Q.map scalarTensorChain. Define integralScalarTensorGoodIso by its unique witness. The component formula is its choose_spec. The theorem itself constructs NatIso.ofComponents and proves uniqueness by Iso.ext and NatTrans.ext, so this data is fully determined. Only the invertibility proof of the fixed chain map uses the separate quasi-isomorphism statement.
